column1: # The message form's cross-leg rules (1) and (2) of the 2026-11-21 review on
# the Luau table runtime (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §3.3), read by
# name is base plus offset held to the announced kind's domain, never
# wrapped: a sum past it is refused, for 8, 64 and 128-bit kinds and where the
# reader is wider than the announced kind. The skip path holds the same sum
# and calls it damage. The lawful twin of every case reads.
# field: the writer's field (writer/Probe.schema) the one message carries;
#        s and z are not the reader's and are skipped.
# offset: the field's three-bit offset from its min; 5 is the kind's top,
# batch: the committed message batch (hex): a body holding field at offset,
#        then the terminator. The test rebuilds it from field and offset under
#        the writer's vocabulary and refuses a drifted fixture.
# want: read or refused (the verdict; the reason is logged, not compared).
# a uint8 announced, read into a uint16
